notes.title: Cloudpunk's cockpit update puts a camera behind the steering wheel
notes.notes:
Ah, the hum of your hover-engine beneath your feet. The pitter-patter of rain on the windshield. The light glow of the GPS as your dispatch screen lights up. Until now, I could only imagine the interior of one of Cloudpunk‘s blocky hover-cabs. That’s all changed with today’s Cockpit Update, which puts you right in the drivers seat for a night’s shift – briefly cutting fares by a third for passengers who’re hopping on for the first time.

(more…)

notes.title: Cockpit Update
notes.notes:
The [b]Cockpit Update[/b] is here.  ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/746850/Cloudpunk/

Experience the city of Nivalis like never before with a fully immersive first person cockpit view. To see it in action, check out the new trailer right here, featuring music from cult synthwave artist [b]Perturbator[/b], with his track [b]Venger (feat. Greta Link)[/b]. We feel incredibly honored to have partnered with Perturbator for this update and we think the song fits our game perfectly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/d7010cb799b6adc76e4af59caae3759fb9173c17.png[/img]

While in the vehicle you can enter the cockpit view via the [b]V[/b] key or [b]DPAD Up[/b] on the controller. You can reassign this to another key that you'd prefer more. 
In cockpit you can steer your vehicle just like before, but driving will feel completely new. Feel the rain dropping on your windshield and the city and all the other cars swoosh by. You may also unlock your camera like before, which allows you to look around inside the car. Look out the side windows and even the new floor windows. Funky! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/20f12d351f51c33b71d5c93082ee02f91c7fe37c.png[/img]

When you approach a parking lot and slow down a bit, a holographic "below the car" view will appear on your windshield making it easier to navigation to the nearest parking slot. The hologram will automatically fade away if you drive off. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/8b4e0a53fba89b58403d90a6b712bc9be14a373a.png[/img]

Don't damage your car too much or the windshield will get cracks limiting your view.

We've also upgraded your apartment by making many of the apartment items interactable. Eat your pizza, take a closer look at your fish tank, turn on your TV and play a game on the retro game console. Try to beat Camus' highscore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/5e8c1af7f8e117a6f1bc0548e3de03d4e9001272.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/0e003df8825dc433a44c80218843cf0aa80b1036.png[/img]

Other changes in this update include performance improvements, smaller level design changes and much smoother controller input with the third and first person cameras. I (Marko) kinda prefer the controller for everything in the game now, but Roman is still a "keyboard+mouse boi" (his words). But we're happy that both feel really balanced and polished.

We hope you will enjoy this update as much we did making it. Let us know your thoughts in the comments below. We also welcome you on our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] for a direct chat with us and other Nivali.

There's more coming in the future, such as the big story update introducing new characters and bringing back old ones, a vehicle constructor and optional racing jobs. But these will take us longer to develop, it'll be like a second game. 

Enjoy!

Control Out

notes.title: Future Update Teaser
notes.notes:
We're happy to be part of this year's [b]Gamescom[/b] and [b]Indie Arena Booth 2020[/b]! 
This year everything is different, so the whole Indie Arena Booth will take place online. You can join it here for free: [url=https://online.indiearenabooth.com/]Indie Arena Booth Online[/url]

In the last weeks since launch we have been testing and plotting behind the scenes to prepare a large update, for which we would like to reveal 2 screenshots right now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/af976b954c11c3e94045dbe34b2348d7a6d77130.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/d85866990b2f3f9ae80cb5535b727fa753d34ff5.png[/img]

Yes, we will bring a [b]cockpit view[/b] to Cloudpunk and it changes driving around the cyberpunk city of Nivalis completely. 

Now, the details of this update are yet to be announced officially, but you know us. We like to tease a little bit and make you excited about what the future brings for the game. What we want to say at this point is that this update will bring a comprehensive story update with multiple hours of gameplay, introducing new characters and bringing back old characters. Furthermore it will add a set of new features around vehicle customization and racing.

We have been prototyping racing and decided we want it to be racing through the city as you know it. There are no specific race tracks, most of these races are semi-legal events through the city of Nivalis. So knowing it well will give you an advantage. As everything that happened to Rania, she will be pulled right into this without much of a choice. She's not a racer, but she needs to become one. 

Adding racing will not entirely change the rather chill nature of the game, however. It will add a nice challenge after you got to know the city. 

Use the comments below to let us know what you think!
You are also welcome to join our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] for a direct chat with us and other Nivali.


Control out.

notes.title: Summer Update (Midweek Madness 25% OFF)
notes.notes:
To celebrate the beginning of summer, we're happy to reveal a [b]Midweek Madness[/b] sale with [b]25% OFF[/b].

While working on more long-term updates, we've just released a small update including a range of improvements and fixes.

What has changed:
[list]
[*]Implemented a savegame rolling backup system. Whenever the game is saved, the current save will be backed up and so will the two saves before that. This is mainly intended for scenarios when your hardware crashes during a save process. This is really rare, but we'd like to prevent it affecting your savegame. So if that happens to you and you can't continue with your game, please either restore one of the backups yourself or contact us directly for assistance at support@ionlands.com 
[*]All voiceover sounds played while in your car have been reprocessed and upgraded for a more interesting effect. This will not change the lines by characters talking to you remotely, like Control.
[*]Fixed a bug when clicking an item in your inventory with your mouse and then hovering to another, which would result in both items being highlighted.
[*]Fixed a bug with moving platforms when running onto them while they are still moving up. It could sometimes cause a situation where the activator stayed green and the platform would only start moving after you left it and entered it again.
[*]Fixed an advertisement vehicle in the Marrow not displaying the billboards all the time.
[*]Tweaked the position of the first person camera. It has been lowered a bit to be exactly at the height of Rania's eyes. We've also slightly lowered the name and interaction UI's on other characters.
[*]When buying apartment upgrades and leaving the window, a savegame is now triggered. There was a confusing situation when you bought something, then left the game without a savegame being triggered and wondering where your stuff was.
[/list]

You are welcome to join our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] for a direct chat with us and other Nivali. 

Also, enjoy the new Cloudpunk key visual:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/4d8b17f28ef6f0f33aced84dcc5cbacb85568c6d.png[/img]

Control out.

notes.title: First Person Camera, Input Update and more
notes.notes:
Over the last couple of weeks we've been overhauling the camera system by adding 2 new modes: [b]Third Person View[/b] and [b]First Person View[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/dd22b0cd1ab8b36e7fba7b3411db38c6634de43f.png[/img]

[h3]Third Person View[/h3]
To unlock your camera and enter third person view you can press X (default). The camera can be rotated around the player with your mouse or the right stick on your controller. When you start walking forward, the player will always walk where your camera is headed. You can also strafe and walk backward. 
Use your mouse wheel to change the distance to the player. Zooming in will ultimately switch to...

[h3]First Person View[/h3]
For full immersion, enter this mode by zooming in the camera all the way until the player disappears. Freely look around with either your mouse or the right stick on your controller. See things that you haven't seen before. But be prepared to see what the world is made of: [b]Voxels[/b]. Lots of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/a6cfa2cd7c84b3ad38a96c756443ceee7ffe8bf2.png[/img]

Decide yourself which camera mode suits your play style best.

[h3]Vehicle Camera[/h3]
The vehicle camera got an upgrade as well. You can now keep the camera unlocked while driving. Look around freely while you drive. 
One of our long-term plans is adding a full first person cockpit view while driving. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/394f506859fc81c84d666b69560e27cf4fb6d1d6.png[/img]

[h3]Mouse Steering[/h3]
Upon request we've added mouse steering for all the keyboard+mouse users. Adjust the mouse sensitivity in the menu to your liking. But please note that the vehicle will not turn more quickly this way. To use mouse steering effectively, it is recommended to use slow & steady left and right moves. 

[h3]Key Bindings[/h3]
The input and key binding system has been overhauled completely as well. It now allows full customization of controller keys. If you like, you could both accelerating, braking, steering left & right to the left stick and use the trigger keys for something else. Your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/bc8aece160114ea9e9f16a1eecb5f5291921c5b3.png[/img]

Furthermore, wherever input actions are referenced in the user interface (i.e. A to TALK), these icons now show the current key binding for either keyboard or controller users. We've also improved the input tutorials at the start of the game and added new tutorials for the camera and overmap.

[h3]Cleaning Robots[/h3]
A welcome addition to the streets of Nivalis are the new cleaning robots. They move from puddle to puddle to clean them up, a hopeless task with the endless rain pouring onto the streets. But they're cute looking and we love them.

Other changes in this update include a range of bugfixes and tweaks to support the new camera modes. We have started working on other more long-term new features and new stories and can't wait to share them with you soon. 

Until then, enjoy your time in Nivalis and come say "Hi" on our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url].

Your ION LANDS team

notes.title: Developer Livestream, Performance & Bugfixes
notes.notes:
It's been nearly two weeks since we launched Cloudpunk and we're overwhelmed by the reception. Many of you have joined our official [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] to give feedback, tell us your suggestions or simply to share your love for the game. It's been really heart-warming for us and we want to thank you all for that.

We've had discussions in the team about the future of the game and decided to do a livestream on Youtube:
[h3][b]Saturday, May 9th, at 5PM CET[/b]
[url=https://youtu.be/_hXNYL-qdcU]Cloudpunk - Dev Stream[/url][/h3]

The livestream will be with Thomas, Roman, Eloise and Marko and we want to chat a bit about the game's development and our long-term vision for the game.

We've also worked on some more fixes and QoL changes in this update.

What has changed:
[list]
[*]Many performance changes. Lower quality levels now have much more impact as they also scale the amount of background vehicles and NPCs. Performance is also increased slightly in the High and Maximum levels because of improved character updating.
[*]It is no longer possible to get locked by Huxley or Pashta. Colliders of interactable NPCs on the streets have been reduced.
[*]Improved the quest removal during the Spire CEO prank choice.
[*]Fixed a rare situation in which talking to a CORPSEC character in the Stacks blocked progress near the gate at Alexa Theatre.
[*]Fixed voiceover lines stopping before the end when skipping and advancing the text.
[*]Fixed some map icons not being displayed or displayed too long.
[*]Fixed the unlocked vehicle camera not being reset properly.
[*]Fixed an empty dialog line with Emit.
[*]Japanese language fixes
[/list]

One more thing, if you're having trouble with your controller not working properly, here's what you can do:

1. Make sure only one controller is connected
2. Activate Xbox configuration support in your Steam settings
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/beed264d3cc94791ca8f61a9bca667c93459bdf5.png[/img]


You are welcome to join our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] for a direct chat with us and other Nivali. 

Control out.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
We have reached early 2020 and we wanted to let you know that we can reveal the launch date very soon. There are so many things to consider when selecting a launch date. 
We are incredibly happy about the game's reception here on Steam so far. Since we brought the page online, Cloudpunk has collected more than 85,000 wishlists, which is incredible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/061955877482033764008def128c80ee537eaa7a.png[/img]

In December we started our voiceover casting calls, listened to hundreds of voice actors and thousands of samples to find the right ones. And we're happy to say that we did. There are over 95 characters in the game and nearly all of them have unique voices. We can't wait to let you hear them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/e1d11a1883975aa8f05b14317d688163f0858b22.jpg[/img]

We also can't wait to let you experience the game. As you know we are going for a very atmospheric, narrative driven game. It's all about the experience of being in this cyberpunk world, learning about the city and its inhabitants and enjoying the music. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/c7b3fa31cbd2823146a3d872ec821aa30db41cfd.jpg[/img]

Right now we're adding the last bits and pieces and optimize performance. Voxel art is difficult to automatically LOD, so we had to create all the LODs manually, a time consuming process.
QA starts next week and localization work is already underway. 

With the help of our newly announced partners for console (Merge Games) we are able to present the game at both PAX East (Feb 27 to Mar 1) and GDC (March 16-20). We hope to make the reveal of the PC launch date inbetween these two events.


As always, let us know your thoughts and questions in the comments below.

Marko

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
When development began on [b]Cloudpunk[/b] back in the summer of 2017, it was just me working on various prototypes while our newborn baby boy explored his first months on this planet. Things were very uncertain and hectic in these times. All I knew and felt was the vision for the game I wanted to make. Later that year I began sharing glimpses of it on social media and the exciting reception by press and players alike was so very encouraging. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lmvgx2B0qKFlUBSemf/giphy.gif[/img]

Since then I’ve been working full time on the game and began growing the team welcoming Thomas our writer, Harry our composer, Billy our portrait artist and Eloise our voxel queen. The art changed a lot and we were able to distill the gameplay to something we believe this game and the story needs. 

I initially thought the game would take around 2 years to complete, so until around fall 2019. There are so many moving pieces and after the positive responses we received, we realized we had new ideas to explore. We now know we will need a bit more time and [b]aim for release in early 2020[/b]. The coming weeks and months will make this goal much clearer and we can’t wait to announce a date once we know it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/a13d0c7df58f2d96bc64bf3b1828c09b4ef40f5d.gif[/img]

We were lucky to partner with Maple Whispering to support us with the PC launch in Asia, a private investor and yet another partner who we can’t wait to reveal very soon. Now the team is growing even more with additional artists and designers helping to flesh out the world. We welcomed Roman, Rebecca, Sergey, Maryam, Kenze Wee, Gordon and Peter, some of which work full time and others half time. I’m proud of you all.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/f94VluJwFCb6fAyUPx/giphy.gif[/img]

So, while things are still very hectic, they have turned much more certain and that’s wonderful. Our next stops are [b]EGX Berlin[/b] and [b]Day of the Devs[/b], where demos will be playable on the show floor. 

As always, let us know your thoughts in the comments below.

Marko

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33897382/5f0ff296b98388d8d1e980d98878815a2f08baac.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

Today I thought to give you an update on how things are progressing and show you a little bit of what's going on behind the scenes.

For those of you seeing this game for the first time, in Cloudpunk you play a courier driving around the sprawling city of Nivalis. On your jobs you will meet interesting, often whimsical, characters whose lives you will affect one way or another. Here are a few of them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33897382/543b4265635f0efacd50efac5e9a413c929ff3fc.png[/img]

You will explore the entire city from the ancient, dark ground to the Spires piercing the thick layer of clouds that hides the sunlight.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33897382/0d9590daf03623863fe568d91b91ccf15f9036bd.png[/img]

What makes this game special is that we're creating everything with voxels - small cubes that form complex buildings, vehicles and characters. Here you can see a screenshot from MagicaVoxel, the free software we're using for all the voxel editing.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33897382/2215f221c3c6d05464bf9e84d93fbbf17a17ba56.png[/img]

Exploring Nivalis you will drive, walk, discover hidden places, items and unlock the stories of the characters you meet. On your delivery jobs you will have choices, and these choices will have a lasting impact on the characters involved. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33897382/cd423d864020cf439c771f3926f4d0ffe59b48d8.png[/img]

The story will be told entirely through dialog, which will come with full voiceovers. For each of the characters we do castings to find the right voices for all of them. This is the fun part in game development.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33897382/cc9f478286c9b1e56b4d472db806314bde8a3474.png[/img]

So right now we're working hard on fleshing out the environment. Building a city is no easy task and takes time. We hope you enjoyed these screenshots.
I'm sure you would like to know more about the release date. At the moment we can't be more specific. To sweeten the wait, you can head over to our Twitter, where I post short clips from time to time.

Talk soon,
ION LANDS
